Supreme Court of Judicature Act
(Chapter 322, Section 73)
List of Touts
N 3
REVISED EDITION 1997
(26th September 1997)
[20th March 1970]
Any person whose name appears in the list of touts published pursuant to section 73 of the Supreme Court of Judicature Act is excluded from the precincts of the Supreme Court except when that person is a party to or a witness in any proceedings in the Supreme Court.
